posts.title: Sekonic’s New Light Meter Aims to Bring Incredibly Precise Measurements of Ambient and Artificial Light
posts.description: Sekonic has announced a new light meter: the L-878D/D-U models build on their predecessor’s metering capabilities while introducing expanded and new features like wireless-flash compatibility, EL Zone System support, additional exposure-comparison tools, and customizable controls. Designed for both photographers and videographers alike, this new all-in-one metering solution should stand out for its incredibly precise measurement capabilities in ambient and artificial light, making it a strong tool for those serious about light metering in cinematography. Let’s check out this new Sekonic L-878D-U Light Meter and what it has to offer. The Sekonic L-878D-U Light Meter From a brand like Sekonic, this new light meter should be a top option for serious cinematographers seeking high-end support for major projects. This new light meter will let photographers and filmmakers use either a 270° rotating, collapsible lumisphere or an integrated 1° spot viewfinder to take incident or reflected light

posts.title: 10 Christmas Movies That Shaped America's National Identity
posts.description: I've been thinking and worrying a lot about America recently. But I've come to the conclusion that there's really nothing I can do to change this country except be a good person and live the best life I can. Well, that, and I hope that around the holiday season the people in charge of this place watch some of these holiday movies that have shaped our cultural identity and that I think have some great lessons. These aren't films just for politicos, but for filmmakers seeking inspiration from the best Christmas movies of all time or for those diving into classic holiday scripts to see how writers balance sentimentality with sharp social critique. posts.title: All The Holiday Characters and Ideas in the Public Domain
posts.description: We've talked about this a few times on here, but intellectual property or recognizable characters are a great way to get more people interested in your screenplay. And when it comes ot the holidays, there are a lot of recognizable characters available to you. But which ones can you use? Well, thankfully, the public domain is here to set you free. It is a goldmine of holiday themes, people, situations, and other ideas ripe for adapting into a modern movie or TV series. Let's dive in. - YouTube www.youtube.com Classic Holiday Characters & Stories Before you start outlining your holiday movie, look at some popular characters you can play with in the public domain. Now, I'll remind you that you can only use elements from the original public-domain source material. Anything added in later, copyrighted adaptations (like specific costume designs, original songs, or character traits) is strictly off-limits.
